content.title: 2026 WNBA Draft Live Stream: How to Watch WNBA
content.text: The 2026 WNBA draft will take place on Monday night in NYC as basketball hopefuls look to land a spot on a team. The 2026 WNBA Draft takes center stage on Monday night at The Shed at Hudson Yards in New York City, ushering in a pivotal moment for a league experiencing rapid growth both on and off the court. With the Dallas Wings holding the No. 1 overall pick for the second straight year, all eyes will be on how they build around reigning Rookie of the Year Paige Bueckers after a strong 2025 campaign. Meanwhile, teams like the Washington Mystics also found success last season with multiple impact rookies, underscoring the importance of this year’s class. How to Watch 2026 WNBA Draft today: Game Date: Monday, April 13, 2026 Game Time: 7:00 p.m. ET TV: ESPN Location: The Shed at Hudson Yards Live stream 2026 WNBA Draft on Fubo: Start watching now! Unlike recent drafts, there’s no clear top selection. Spanish international standout Awa Fam and UConn guard Azzi Fudd headline a deep and competitive field, with Olivia Miles and Lauren Betts also projected lottery picks. Early mock drafts suggest Dallas could lean toward Fam’s size and versatility; however, a reconnection of Azzi Fudd and Paige Bueckers could provide years of dominance in Dallas. The Minnesota Lynx and Seattle Storm may target backcourt playmakers like Miles or Fudd in the top three if they are still available. Beyond the top tier, UCLA’s national championship core could dominate the first round, while players such as Raven Johnson and Ta’Niya Latson bring additional depth to a loaded class. This year’s draft is especially significant as it coincides with major expansion. The Toronto Tempo and Portland Fire will make their debuts this season, each with mid-first-round picks and rosters built through recent expansion drafts. The teams’ arrival signals a new era of opportunity and competition across the league. Even more growth is on the horizon, with the WNBA recently announcing future expansion franchises in Cleveland, Detroit and Philadelphia as part of a plan to reach 18 teams by 2030. With elite talent entering the league and expansion reshaping the landscape, Monday night’s draft could define the WNBA’s next generation. What Time Is the 2026 WNBA Draft?
